name: Taroki Polish, call king
description: Taroki z królami (Taroki call king) is a four-player Polish tarot game from Kozy near Bielsko Biała. Bidder chooses partner by calling a King (not the XIX). 54-card pack, 22 trumps; highest skiż, then XXI down to I, the lowest trump. Objective: bidder's side wins by taking more than half the card points in tricks. Bonuses for all kings, last trick with lowest trump, etc. Card values: skiż/XXI/kings 5, queens 4, cavaliers 3, jacks 2, others 1. From Austrian Tarock tradition in Galicia/Silesia.

setup.players: Four players; temporary partnerships (declarer plus holder of called king vs others, or declarer alone vs three).
setup.deck: 54-card Taroki pack: 22 trumps (skiż, XXI down to I) and four eight-card suits (K, Q, C, J plus four pips).
setup.dealing: Dealer deals 6 cards face down to table (talon), then remaining 48 in batches of 6 so each player receives 12 cards; anticlockwise. Player opposite dealer may refuse to cut; then dealer deals 6 to talon and four packets of 12, and each player in turn chooses a packet.

rules.objective: Declarer's team wins by capturing more than half the card points (at least 35 of 70) in tricks plus their share of the talon. Opponents win if they have 35 or more. Game and bonuses (trul, last-trick-with-lowest-trump, kings, etc.) are scored and paid independently.
rules.gameplay: Deal: 6 cards to talon, then 12 to each player in two rounds of 6; anticlockwise. Optional throw-in if dealt no taroks; optional declaration of four kings before bidding. Bidding: Forant (right of dealer) starts; each player once may bid 1–4 (talon cards to take) or pass; 4 only after a 3. Declarer calls a king by suit; its holder is partner (secret). Optional king ultimo, kontra. Talon exchange: declarer takes 0–3 cards per bid, discards same number; may not discard 5-point cards or taroks unless unavoidable. Announcements: trul, last-trick-with-lowest-trump, taroki count, etc., in anticlockwise order from declarer. Play: Forant leads; must follow suit or play a tarok; if no suit and no tarok, any card (cannot win). Trick to highest tarok, else highest of led suit. Winner leads next.
keyRules: Must follow suit or play tarok; if no tarok, must play suit if possible
22 trumps (skiż highest, I lowest); taroks beat plain suits
Declarer's team needs 35+ points to win the game
Card points: skiż/XXI/lowest trump/kings 5, queens 4, cavaliers 3, jacks 2, rest 1
